lines.text: That private jet photo? It might be a studio in East L.A.
The Lambo, the mansion, the jet, the Birkin. Rich, right?
The Lamborghini: rentals in L.A. start around a thousand a day.
The mansion: listed by the hour. Four hours, about eight hundred.
The jet set: around forty-five dollars an hour.
The Birkin: a rental membership, eight hundred a month.
One rich-looking photo day: about twenty-eight hundred dollars. Owned at the end: nothing.
Next time you see the jet pic: real, or rented?

footnote: Estimates from LA rental listings (Pugachev, Peerspace, FD Photo Studio, Vivrelle). People shown are stock models, not real creators.
